flowContents.comments: Self-healing test pack: Holdout: billing, parcels and pharmacy. Built by flows/build_all.py.
flowContents.name: nfh-p26-holdout-a

processGroups.comments: S103 Rate Call does 4/s, one task every 250 ms, against 6/s of switch and roaming records: its queue grows by 120 a minute. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S103 Call Rating Behind

processGroups.comments: S104 Geofence Check runs its two tasks every 5 seconds, 0.4/s against 3 scans/s, so it is idle most of the time while its queue grows. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S104 Geofence Check On A Slow Schedule

processGroups.comments: Prescriptions arrive at 10.25/s and S105 Write Dispense Record does 10/s: its queue grows by 15 a minute and breaches its threshold hours after deploy. (symptom: backlog)
processGroups.name: S105 Dispense Writer Slightly Behind

processGroups.comments: None. For five minutes each hour a manifest backfill fills the loader's queue to about 70% of its alert, and it drains within five minutes. (symptom: healthy)
processGroups.name: S106 Hourly Backfill That Drains
